tools.name: pm_search
tools.description: Use this first when the user asks what Polymarket thinks about a topic, how likely something is, or names a market without a link. Searches every Polymarket market by keyword (Polymarket's own full-text search) or by a polymarket.com link and returns events with all their outcomes, current prices, 2

tools.name: pm_market
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about one Polymarket market or event: its price, what exactly decides how it resolves, whether an outcome has been proposed or disputed, when it ends, its fees, or how it has moved. Returns prices, bid/ask and spread, change over 1h/24h/7d/30d with a 30-day range, volume

tools.name: pm_book
tools.description: Use this when the user asks how liquid a Polymarket market is, how much a trade of a given size would really cost, how far it would move the price, or what the order book looks like. Returns the live book for one outcome: best levels, spread, dollar depth near the mid and which side is heavier. With

tools.name: pm_flow
tools.description: Use this when the user asks who is buying or selling a Polymarket market, why its price moved, where the money is going, who the biggest holders are, or (with no market) what the whales are doing across Polymarket. For a market or event: dollars traded and net direction per outcome, distinct wallets

tools.name: pm_moves
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what is moving, trending or changing on Polymarket, what moved overnight or this week, or for the biggest gainers and losers. Ranks the 300 most-traded open markets by price change over the last hour, day, week or month, with old and current price, the move in percentage

tools.name: pm_leaderboard
tools.description: Use this when the user asks who the best or biggest Polymarket traders are, who made the most money today, this week, this month or all time, or who leads in a category (politics, sports, crypto, economics, finance, culture, tech, weather, mentions). Returns Polymarket's own leaderboard ranked by pr

tools.name: pm_portfolio
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what a Polymarket trader or wallet holds, how good a trader is, or wants to size up a wallet seen in pm_flow. Returns the track record (all-time and 30-day profit and loss, volume, leaderboard rank, markets traded), open positions with entry and current price, unrealized
